title: Length-preserving padded decoder
statement: Given two finite Boolean lists $s$ and $v$, let $u$ be the prefix returned by splitting $v$ at its last true entry, when such an entry exists. The decoder returns $u$ if its length equals the length of $s$, and returns $s$ otherwise; in particular, it returns $s$ when $v$ has no true entry.
